reproduce.title: Validate Command Palette Indexer to Peek launch
prerequisites: A local file indexed by Windows Search.
steps: Find a local file using the Search files (Indexer) extension.
Open More commands or press Ctrl+Space and choose Open in Peek.
Observe whether Command Palette closes and whether Peek opens the selected file.
Apply the working-directory approach from PR #49512 locally and repeat.
reproduce.expected_result: Peek opens the selected indexed file when Open in Peek is invoked.

judgment.rationale: The issue provides a short deterministic Command Palette sequence. PR #49512 attempted to launch Peek.UI with the correct working directory but is closed and unmerged, so the defect still needs validation rather than being marked handled.
evidence: Searching for a file through the Indexer extension and invoking Open in Peek closes Command Palette without showing Peek.

judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on the current development build, apply the linked working-directory approach locally, and verify Peek opens the selected file.
